categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Korrun Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of travel goods including leisure bags, travel suitcases, business bags, clothing, and related accessories. The company has two main business models: OEM manufacturing for global brands and brand operation with its own brand '90 Points' and cooperation with Xiaomi. In 2024, it expanded into textile and apparel manufacturing through the acquisition of Shanghai Jiale, entering the knitwear and fabric production sector.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced automated, intelligent, digital, and lean manufacturing processes to improve production efficiency and quality. It has a vertically integrated production chain in textile and apparel, including fabric development, dyeing, cutting, sewing, and finishing. R&D focuses on functional and innovative materials such as waterproof, antibacterial, UV-resistant, graphene-based, and eco-friendly fabrics. The company also emphasizes digital transformation and smart factory management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include internationally renowned brands such as Nike, Decathlon, VF Group, Uniqlo, Adidas, PUMA, MUJI, Dell, HP, and Asus. The company serves the global sports, leisure, and business travel goods markets, with a growing presence in apparel manufacturing for major global brands. Its products are sold primarily to brand owners and retailers in mature markets like the US and Europe, as well as emerging markets in Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: Anhui Korrun operates manufacturing bases in China (Chuzhou, Shanghai), Indonesia, and India, leveraging cost and tariff advantages. Overseas production accounts for over 70% of capacity. The company’s sales cover domestic China and international markets, including the US, Europe, Southeast Asia, and emerging markets. It has established subsidiaries and joint ventures in Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, the US, Mexico, and other countries to support global operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the textile and travel goods supply chain. It is a leading OEM manufacturer providing design, development, and production services to global brands, and also engages in brand operation and retail. Its vertical integration extends into fabric and apparel manufacturing, enhancing control over upstream raw materials and production processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on high-quality development, global capacity expansion, and digital transformation. It prioritizes innovation in functional textiles, smart manufacturing, and sustainable green production aligned with China's dual carbon goals. The acquisition of Shanghai Jiale marks a strategic move into knitwear and fabric manufacturing, aiming to build a second growth curve. R&D efforts target lightweight, eco-friendly, and technologically advanced materials to meet evolving consumer demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through OEM manufacturing contracts with global brands, involving product sales based on FOB and other trade terms. The company also earns revenue from brand operations via direct online sales, distribution, and cost-plus or profit-sharing arrangements with partners like Xiaomi. Additional income comes from investment returns and government subsidies related to innovation and green initiatives.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Anhui Korrun is positioned as a leading professional manufacturer in the highly competitive and fragmented Chinese travel goods and textile industry. It competes with numerous domestic and international OEMs but differentiates itself through advanced manufacturing, global capacity layout, and strong brand partnerships. The company holds a stable position with top-tier clients and is expanding its market share in apparel manufacturing through strategic acquisitions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved record revenues exceeding 4.2 billion RMB, a 36.56% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of approximately 380 million RMB, up 229.52%. The company’s total assets grew by 43.57% to over 5.15 billion RMB. The rapid growth is driven by expanded production capacity, acquisition of Shanghai Jiale, and strengthened global supply chain capabilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Anhui Korrun emphasizes high-quality, innovative, and functional travel goods and textiles, integrating advanced manufacturing technologies and sustainable practices. Its global production footprint offers cost and tariff advantages, ensuring stable delivery and competitive pricing. The company’s strong R&D capabilities and strategic partnerships with leading brands provide differentiated products with superior design, technology, and sustainability credentials, enhancing customer loyalty and market competitiveness.
